brief:
**BLUF:** No major incidents reported in Tazewell County or immediate core area (Tazewell, Richlands, Bluefield VA, Cedar Bluff, Princeton/Bluefield WV, Mercer County) in the last 24 hours. Regionally, a Summers County WV school faced a bomb threat with a juvenile in custody; a WV deputy was injured in an I-77 crash; two people died in a southern WV highway crash; and Princeton Community Hospital earned top patient safety marks.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/breaking-news/alleged-bomb-threat-at-jumping-branch-elementary-school/)

## LAW ENFORCEMENT AND COURTS
**Core:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

**Region:** Summers County Sheriff’s Office and WV State Police responded to a bomb threat at Jumping Branch Elementary School in Jumping Branch, WV, on November 19; the school was evacuated, no explosives found, and a juvenile suspect is in custody after prior threats. Route 3 was closed during the response.[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/breaking-news/alleged-bomb-threat-at-jumping-branch-elementary-school/)

A Wyoming County man was convicted on multiple charges including solicitation of a minor (details per WOAY reporting on November 18).[[2]](https://swvasun.com/crash-kills-tazewell-man-p4992-26.htm)

A West Virginia deputy was injured after a patrol cruiser was struck from behind on I-77 (Lootpress, November 18).[[2]](https://swvasun.com/crash-kills-tazewell-man-p4992-26.htm)

Two people were killed in a crash on a southern West Virginia highway (Lootpress, November 19).[[3]](https://www.bdtonline.com/news/local_news/more-than-2-000-have-already-voted-early-in-tazewell-county/article_a8d5d78b-a0da-454e-b272-7c21743d3b68.html)

## FIRE, EMS AND RESCUE
**Core:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

**Region:** Nothing additional reported beyond the Summers County school response noted above.

## HAZARDS, WEATHER AND ROADS
**Core:** No active NWS alerts. No reported power outages, flooding, or road closures on US-19, US-460, US-52, Route 16, or Route 67.

**Region:** WV deputy injured in I-77 incident noted above. No other major interstate or severe weather impacts reported in the last 24 hours.

## GOVERNMENT AND POLITICS
**Core:** Nothing reported in the last 24 hours.

**Region:** Plans laid out for a proposed data center complex in Russell County, VA (WJHL, November 19).[[4]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/crime/mercer-county-crime/bluefield-west-virginia-police-department-releases-bench-warrant-list-55/)

City of Bluefield issued a warning about a potential holiday scam tied to the Holiday of Lights event (WOAY, November 19).[[5]](https://wind-reports.com/United-States/Virginia/Tazewell-County/Sayersville/)

WV Treasurer’s agenda includes data centers and teacher pay (Bluefield Daily Telegraph, November 19).[[6]](https://www.publicschoolreview.com/virginia/tazewell-county)

Generation West Virginia received a $1.84M grant for a statewide internship program (Bluefield Daily Telegraph, November 19).[[7]](https://www.zillow.com/tazewell-county-va/newest/)

## ECONOMY AND OTHER
**Core:** WVU Medicine Princeton Community Hospital (Mercer County, WV) earned an “A” in patient safety from the Leapfrog Group (WOAY, November 19).[[8]](https://panhandlenewsnetwork.com/2026/11/19/specific-threat-called-in-to-washington-high-school-causes-evacuation-le-clear-scene/)

A Mercer County mother joined an autism advocacy group’s board (Bluefield Daily Telegraph, November 19).[[1]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/breaking-news/alleged-bomb-threat-at-jumping-branch-elementary-school/)

**Region:** County employers in WV oppose a proposed 24% rate increase for the public insurance plan (Bluefield Daily Telegraph, November 18).[[9]](https://www.wvnstv.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-virginia/three-people-arrested-and-charged-after-reported-vehicle-break-ins-in-part-of-tazewell-county/)

FCC approved signal jamming for contraband cellphones in state prisons (Bluefield Daily Telegraph, November 19).[[10]](https://www.centralillinoisproud.com/news/local-news/tazewell-county-medal-honor-monument/)

## WATCH -- NEXT 48 HOURS
- Richlands Boys Varsity Basketball at LCCHS (MaxPreps, November 19).[[11]](https://ow.ly/Tpil50ReYLg)
- “What’s Happening in West Virginia” events November 20–22 (WVVA).[[12]](https://cardinalnews.org/2026/10/22/sjn-tazewell-county-restructuring/)
- Ongoing regional data center discussions and grant implementations.
